title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed, Xbox New Zealand Trick
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Discover global unlock times and whether the classic Xbox New Zealand trick still works.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times and Platform Details

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the launch of Rockstar Games' next monumental open-world title, new details have emerged regarding its release schedule. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, **Grand Theft Auto 6** is officially scheduled to arrive on **19th November** for **PlayStation 5** and **Xbox Series X/S**. 

However, while the calendar date is set for November 19, the exact moment players can actually jump into the game will vary depending on where they are located across the globe. Due to regional time zone differences, staggered rollouts are expected, prompting players to look closely at local unlock schedules.

## The Classic Xbox New Zealand Trick

With global unlock times varying by region, the gaming community has quickly turned its attention to traditional workarounds. Eurogamer notes that Xbox owners can seemingly still use the old "New Zealand trick" to play early. This long-running method, which involves adjusting console region settings to tap into earlier time zones, has historically allowed eager Xbox Series X/S owners to bypass local midnight launches and start playing hours ahead of schedule.

In contrast, PlayStation 5 players generally face stricter regional bindings tied directly to their PlayStation Network account store regions, making similar workarounds much harder to pull off. As a result, Xbox platforms continue to be a popular topic of discussion among fans looking for any possible way to get into Los Santos or the wider state of Leonida a little bit sooner.

## Editor's Take

As November 19 approaches, anticipation for GTA6 is reaching a fever pitch. While waiting for staggered global rollouts can be frustrating, checking regional unlock details helps ensure you are ready the moment servers go live. Whether the New Zealand trick ultimately works as expected on Xbox Series X/S remains a fun talking point, but planning your download and preload times ahead is the safest bet for day-one readiness.
